scope: Fixed-input, same-control experiments; ratios are reference time / candidate time. Interaction time factors have separate direction. Different studies are not pooled or multiplied. Times are the declared internal solver/interface/kernel durations, normalized to raw clock; process windows separately witness clocks and load. Browser loading is outside this comparison.
host: Intel Core i9-13900K, WSL2, f64 unless explicitly a precision comparison
clocks: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW with independent Windows QPC witness; adjusted durations normalized separately
uncertainty: Intervals describe paired repeatability on this desktop, not machine-independent accuracy. Filtered pairs are selected by host measurements alone; all numerical samples must pass. Strict admitted estimates retain their original bootstrap; secondary analyses use the declared amendment.
limitations: No direct DRAM bandwidth or energy measurement
Instrumented diagnostics and numerical failures have no accepted latency ratio
